metadata.question: Does Lake Erie have more ice coverage compared to the other Great Lakes in February 14, 2018 afternoon?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need to compare ice coverage across all Great Lakes (Superior, Michigan, Huron, Erie, Ontario) - Date: February 14, 2018 (winter, so ice is expected) - Use MODIS Terra or Aqua for ice detection (thermal bands or NDSI) - Could use Sentinel-2 but may have cloud issues in winter - MODIS MOD10A1 (Terra) or MYD10A1 (Aqua) daily snow/ice product would be ideal - For afternoon: use Aqua (MYD) which passes around 1:30 PM 2. Masking strategy: - Use MODIS snow/ice product which has ice extent band - Or use NDSI (Normalized Difference Snow Index) from MODIS - Need to distinguish ice from clouds and water 3. Logic: - Calculate ice coverage (km² or %) for each Great Lake - Compare Erie to others (Superior, Michigan, Huron, Ontario) - Valid result: ice coverage values for all lakes - C1: No images for that date - C2: No valid pixels after masking - C3: Calculation returns None/NaN - A: Erie has MORE ice than all others - B: Erie does NOT have more ice than all others ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Great Lakes geometries (approximate boundaries) const lakes = { 'Superior': ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[-92.0, 46.5], [-92.0, 48.5], [-84.5, 48.5], [-84.5, 46.5], [-92.0, 46.5]] ]), 'Michigan': ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[-87.5, 41.5], [-87.5, 46.0], [-84.5, 46.0], [-84.5, 41.5], [-87.5, 41.5]] ]), 'Huron': ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[-84.5, 43.0], [-84.5, 46.5], [-79.5, 46.5], [-79.5, 43.0], [-84.5, 43.0]] ]), 'Erie': ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[-83.5, 41.3], [-83.5, 42.9], [-78.9, 42.9], [-78.9, 41.3], [-83.5, 41.3]] ]), 'Ontario': ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[-79.8, 43.2], [-79.8, 44.3], [-76.0, 44.3], [-76.0, 43.2], [-79.8, 43.2]] ]) }; const date = '2018-02-14'; // Try MODIS Aqua Snow Cover (afternoon pass) let collection = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MYD10A1') .filterDate(date, ee.Date(date).advance(1, 'day')) .select('NDSI_Snow_Cover'); const size = collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`MODIS Aqua images found: ${size}`); if (size === 0) { // Fallback to Terra (morning pass) collection = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD10A1') .filterDate(date, ee.Date(date).advance(1, 'day')) .select('NDSI_Snow_Cover'); const terraSize = collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`MODIS Terra images found: ${terraSize}`); if (terraSize === 0) { console.log('No MODIS data available for this date'); console.log('C1'); return; } } const image = collection.mosaic(); // NDSI_Snow_Cover: 0-100 = NDSI snow cover, 200 = missing data, 201 = no decision, // 211 = night, 237 = inland water, 239 = ocean, 250 = cloud, 254 = detector saturated, 255 = fill // We want ice/snow coverage (values 0-100, higher values indicate more ice/snow) const iceMask = image.gte(10).and(image.lte(100)); // NDSI > 10% indicates ice/snow const results = {}; // Calculate ice coverage for each lake for (const [name, geometry] of Object.entries(lakes)) { const stats = image.updateMask(iceMask).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: geometry, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const icePixels = stats.get('NDSI_Snow_Cover').getInfo(); // Also get total pixels to calculate percentage const totalStats = image.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: geometry, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const totalPixels = totalStats.get('NDSI_Snow_Cover').getInfo(); if (icePixels === null || totalPixels === null || totalPixels === 0) { console.log(`${name}: No valid data`); results[name] = 0; } else { const percentage = (icePixels / totalPixels) * 100; results[name] = percentage; console.log(`${name}: ${percentage.toFixed(1)}% ice coverage (${icePixels} pixels)`); } } // Check if we have valid results const validResults = Object.values(results).filter(v => v !== null && !isNaN(v)); if (validResults.length === 0) { console.log('C3'); return; } // Compare Erie to other lakes const erieIce = results['Erie']; const otherLakes = ['Superior', 'Michigan', 'Huron', 'Ontario']; let erieHasMore = true; for (const lake of otherLakes) { if (results[lake] >= erieIce) { erieHasMore = false; console.log(`${lake} has equal or more ice than Erie`); break; } } if (erieHasMore) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
